title: PEAR: Adaptive Advantage Reshaping for Perception and Exploration in Large Vision-Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.32216v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Effective multimodal reasoning requires a model to reliably utilize visual information while sufficiently exploring diverse reasoning paths. To achieve this goal, prior work combines visual dependency and token entropy to reshape sequence-level advantages, but scaling the contribution of token entropy by visual dependency can leave high-entropy tokens with low visual dependency underweighted, despite their important role in reasoning exploration. To address this limitation, we propose PEAR, an adaptive advantage reshaping method for improving perception and exploration in multimodal reasoning. translated_title: PEAR：面向大型视觉语言模型感知与探索的自适应优势重塑方法
translated_abstract: 有效的多模态推理要求模型既能可靠地利用视觉信息，又能充分探索多样化的推理路径。为实现这一目标，先前的工作将视觉依赖与词元熵相结合来重塑序列级优势，但用视觉依赖对词元熵的贡献进行缩放，可能导致视觉依赖较低的高熵词元被低估权重，尽管这些词元在推理探索中发挥着重要作用。为解决这一局限，我们提出了PEAR，一种用于提升多模态推理中感知与探索能力的自适应优势重塑方法。PEAR保留视觉依赖作为基础信号，并仅在高熵位置加入基于熵的探索增益，且视觉依赖越低，附加增益越大。随后，融合信号被映射为正的词元级权重，用以重塑序列级优势。在Qwen2.5-VL-3B/7B上的实验表明，PEAR取得了显著的性能提升。
tldr: PEAR提出一种自适应优势重塑方法，以视觉依赖为基础信号、仅在高熵位置施加与视觉依赖高低挂钩的熵探索增益，从而同时提升大型视觉语言模型多模态推理中的感知与探索能力。
en_tdlr: PEAR proposes an adaptive advantage reshaping method that retains visual dependency as the base signal and adds an entropy-based exploration gain only at high-entropy positions, improving both perception and exploration in multimodal reasoning of large vision-language models.
